name: Kaeya
notes: Both sources: 4pc Blizzard Strayer, a Cryo DMG goblet, CRIT circlet, Mistsplitter Reforged first. They differ on the talent order and the role: KQM puts the Burst first as a Cryo applicator (Burst > Skill >> Normal Attack, with a table of ER by team size), while Game8 lists Normal Attack > Burst > Skill for its main-DPS builds and a Physical Support build with Skyward Blade. The card keeps the Burst first, as KQM does. KQM's ER table (115-285 by team and constellation) has columns that did not parse, so no ER goal is set. Neither source gives other numeric goals; only the Cryo goblet value is set. Re-checked against a third source (genshin-builds.com, October 29, 2026): Freeze/mono Cryo and Reverse Melt builds, 4pc Blizzard Strayer first then Emblem of Severed Fate and Noblesse Oblige, ATK% sands, Cryo DMG goblet, CRIT DMG circlet, Mistsplitter Reforged first, substats ER > CRIT DMG > ATK% > CRIT Rate, and talents Burst > Normal Attack > Skill. With Game8 putting Normal Attack ahead of Skill as well, the order is changed from KQM's Burst > Skill >> Normal Attack to Burst > Normal Attack > Skill (two of three sources). It gives no numeric goals.
